The corpus provides clear, multiple, and convergent support with no conflict.

scores.rationale: None of the 18 snippets directly address the relationship between N:C ratio and irradiance under nutrient-replete conditions. The snippets cover diverse topics including nitrogen fertilization of crops, photosynthesis responses to temperature/UVR, stoichiometry in plants and zooplankton, and reproductive energy allocation, but none provide quantitative or qualitative evidence linking increased irradiance to decreased N:C ratios. Snippet 9 mentions low C:X ratios in high nutrient environments and irradiance-governed photosynthesis but does not establish the irradiance-N:C relationship. The corpus is essentially off-topic with respect to the stylized fact, providing neither support nor contradiction, so evidence is sparse and the direction cannot be determined.
